title: Render Int negations of zero as differences in Lean certificates
summary: The Lean reconstruction now writes the negation of an always-zero Int term as 0 - t instead of -t, which avoids a defect of the pinned Lean's grind tactic that made the kernel reject certificates of inputs such as (f (- 0)). The workaround is partial: zeros reached without a negation in the input still fail as before.
